row:
Welcome to the YouTube channel for Barn Besties LLC! We are two life-long horsewomen living in Wisconsin, who have built and managed barns for most of our lives. We've learned a lot about building and managing horse farms, unfortunately usually learning the hard and often times expensive way! We're here to share our knowledge and experiences to help you make the best decisions when building your farm, to save you time and money! 

2026 Publishing Schedule (Central Time Zone): Mondays to Fridays at 7:15 am. Be sure to check out our Short videos published daily!

Contact us: Barnbestiesllc@gmail.com
LinkTree: https://linktr.ee/BarnBesties
